text:
Zoe B: Quick UX check on the small 'bulk-import' form. Two UX threads: where to put contextual help (tooltip vs persistent helper line) and what confirmation pattern to use for bulk destructive actions. My thought: prefer a single persistent one-line helper under the field for density, with optional tooltip for advanced tips. For bulk delete (n>5) require a typed-count confirm (type the number of items) rather than typing a name. Opinions? Marcus L: I like the typed-count idea for bulk since names get messy. For the helper, persistent line is more discoverable than hover-only tooltips (which fail on touch). But we should make the helper visually subtle and link to an extended docs modal. Hana G: Accessibility note: persistent helper should be connected with aria-describedby so screen readers announce it when the input receives focus. Tooltips must be keyboard-accessible and not the only source of critical info. Also prefer explicit 'Required' over just '*' on small screens. Zoe B: Updated pattern proposal: 1) Use a persistent helper line beneath inputs (compact style, muted color) with an inline link "Learn more" that opens docs modal. 2) Only show inline validation on blur or on submit; 3) For bulk destructive actions: if count <=5, show typed-name confirm per-item; if count >5 require typed-count confirm and a checkbox "I understand this cannot be undone". 4) Helper must have id and inputs use aria-describedby. Marcus L: Example aria snippet for the spec: ```html
Enter how many items to remove. Learn more
``` This keeps the helper discoverable and avoids relying on hover. Hana G: For the typed-count confirm microcopy: "To confirm, type the number of items to permanently delete: 12" and disable the confirm button until the exact count is entered. Also add aria-live polite region when the validation banner appears. DesignBot: prototype-lint: /design/prototypes/bulk-import shows tooltip-only helper for import-count. Two inputs missing aria-describedby. Flagging as issues. Zoe B: Vote: :thumbsup: for persistent helper + blur-show errors + typed-count(>5) + per-item typed-name(<=5) + checkbox for >5. Reply with reaction. Marcus L: :thumbsup: will add the aria-describedby examples and a brief mobile variant (label shows 'Required' pill). Hana G: :thumbsup: I will add aria-live banner guidance and include contrast checks for the helper text. Zoe B: Thanks I'll update the Figma spec, include the code snippets and open a PR. DesignBot: spec PR #541 opened with persisted helper pattern, typed-count confirmation, and accessibility checklist.
